title: The injected program name escapes the exec allowlist after rendering
rationale: permits.exec grants git only; the page renders argv[0] to curl — the runtime checks the RENDERED program against the allowlist and refuses before spawn; the mock shell records zero executions — SUPERSEDED: the order law (spec 10 · NIKA-SEC-015) refuses this file BEFORE the runtime gate can be reached: `run_it` shells on content `fetch_page` fetched. The fixture's own header said « the static lane is blind here by design: the program name is dynamic » — true of the NAME, false of the ROUTE. RECLASSIFIED 2026-08-13 under the runtime-fixture contract « if the static lane now catches it, reclassify »
